findings.title: 1. Remove duplicated finding payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The same guardrail failures are represented twice, once in `evaluations` and again in top-level `observations`, with largely duplicated fields. This increases artifact size and creates drift risk because the two copies already differ in `findingId`, `fingerprint`, and one `reportedAt` value.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical representation. For example, make `evaluations[].observations` the source of truth and remove top-level `observations`, or keep top-level `observations` and have `evaluations` reference observation IDs instead of embedding duplicate objects.

findings.title: 2. Preserve per-location identity for repeated findings
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R2  
**Issue:** Multiple `prioritize-requirements` failures at different locators share the same `findingId` and `fingerprint` inside `evaluations`, even though they point to different locations such as `$.decisionMap.deferredToSpec[0]`, `[1]`, and `[2]`. This makes deduplication and repair targeting ambiguous.  
**Suggestion:** Include the locator, requirement reference, or another stable location component in the fingerprint input so repeated rule violations at different locations remain distinguishable.

findings.title: 3. Consolidate empty review artifact structure
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-review-coverage.json`  
**Requirement:** R3  
**Issue:** `draft-review-coverage.json` and `draft-review-questions.json` have identical structure and only differ by phase, source timing, and filename. If these are hand-authored or generated by nearby logic, this duplication suggests the artifact schema is being repeated rather than reused.  
**Suggestion:** Use a shared review artifact template/schema for empty PASS reviews, parameterized by `phase`, `sourceDraft`, and `generatedAt`, so future changes to review artifact fields happen in one place.

findings.title: 4. Consolidate empty triage/repair artifact structure
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-coverage-triage.json`  
**Requirement:** R4  
**Issue:** The triage and repair artifacts repeat the same empty-result shape across coverage and questions flows: `version`, `phase`, source pointer, `generatedAt`, `summary`, and empty `items`. This is low-value duplication and can produce inconsistent summaries or field names over time.  
**Suggestion:** Generate these from a common empty-artifact helper or schema, with the source field name and summary text supplied as parameters.

findings.title: 1. Deduplicate Requirement Path Lists
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/file-map.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** R2, R3, and R4 repeat the same implementation/test file list, and R6/R7 repeat most of it. This creates maintenance drift when the touched surface changes.  
**Suggestion:** If the schema allows it, introduce a shared lifecycle-policy file group or generate this map from canonical requirement metadata instead of hand-emitting repeated arrays.

findings.title: 5. Collapse Duplicate Deferred Finding Fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow-findings.json`  
**Requirement:** R6  
**Issue:** Each entry repeats identical values in `sourceFindingId` and `fingerprint`, and stores both `disposition` and `finalDisposition`, which can drift or conflict.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical finding identifier and one current/final state field, or document/enforce distinct semantics if both are required.

findings.title: 2. Add Failure Policy To Hook Snapshots
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** `plugins.flowCommandHooks` snapshot entries include `command`, `hook`, and `priority`, but omit the new failure policy metadata. That makes the generated flow snapshot inconsistent with the required-hook policy contract.  
**Suggestion:** Add explicit `failurePolicy` values to each hook snapshot entry, such as `"required"` or `"advisory"`.

findings.title: 3. Bound Retained Flow History
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Large arrays such as `metrics`, `reviewConvergence.records[].evidenceHistory`, `stepAttempts`, and `reviewRecoveryBaselines` can grow indefinitely across repeated flow/review attempts, violating the bounded-resource-usage guardrail.  
**Suggestion:** Add a retention policy, for example latest N records per phase/task plus `omittedCount` or truncation metadata.

findings.title: 4. Remove Stale In-Progress State
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The `impl-review` step is still marked `"in_progress"` even though later artifacts show implementation review completed and subsequent gates ran. This makes the flow artifact internally inconsistent.  
**Suggestion:** Regenerate or update the flow state so `impl-review` has a completed status and matching `finishedAt`/runtime metadata.

findings.title: 6. Filter Out-Of-Scope Triage Items Before Persisting
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/impl-triage.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The triage artifact stores many rejected proposals for files outside the provided diff scope. That creates noisy generated state and makes the actionable review surface harder to inspect.  
**Suggestion:** Persist only triage items for touched files, or compact out-of-scope rejected findings into a bounded summary count.

findings.title: 7. Deduplicate Issue Log Payloads And Add Retention
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/issue-log.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Entries repeat the same long text across `reason`, `observations`, and `failedEvaluations`, and the log appends detailed payloads without a visible size/count bound.  
**Suggestion:** Store canonical observations once, make summary fields reference or summarize them, and enforce max retained entries or max payload size.

findings.title: 8. Reduce Bilingual Drift
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/issue.md`  
**Requirement:** R2  
**Issue:** The English and Japanese sections duplicate the full issue body, including Summary, Decision, Requirements, Scope, Acceptance Criteria, and Evidence. This creates two sources of truth.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical requirements section and make the localized section a concise translation summary, or explicitly mark one section as authoritative.

findings.title: 9. Remove Redundant Issue Number State
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/plugin-artifacts/workflow/prepare.json`  
**Requirement:** R2  
**Issue:** The artifact stores the same issue number as both top-level `issue` and `result.issueNumber`.  
**Suggestion:** Store the issue number once, preferably in the structured `result` object unless the top-level field is required as an artifact key.

findings.title: 10. Avoid Committing Transient Workflow Mutation State
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/plugin-artifacts/workflow/prepare.json`  
**Requirement:** R4  
**Issue:** The artifact records transient board/workflow mutation details like `"status": "In Progress"`, `"changed": true`, and `"previousStatus": "Todo"`. These are operational side effects rather than durable spec data.  
**Suggestion:** Exclude transient mutation results from committed artifacts, or move them into bounded local run evidence.

findings.title: 11. Bound Repair Fingerprint Entry Growth
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/repair-fingerprint.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `entries` records every changed path with full hash metadata, and repeated repair/regression cycles can grow this artifact without an explicit visible cap.  
**Suggestion:** Add a maximum retained entry count or compact unchanged/repeated metadata into a summary with `omittedCount` when the list exceeds the bound.

findings.title: 1. Pretty-print generated review evidence JSON
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/5cac57cb5799a07696840b35dd38cc5e76de494b284a4353af4b286282a7fbec.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The file is a very large single-line JSON object, which makes review, conflict resolution, and targeted edits unnecessarily difficult.  
**Suggestion:** Emit review evidence with stable pretty-printing, for example `JSON.stringify(record, null, 2) + "\n"`, and apply the same formatting convention to these evidence artifacts.

findings.title: 2. Deduplicate repeated finding identity fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/5cac57cb5799a07696840b35dd38cc5e76de494b284a4353af4b286282a7fbec.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Every finding stores both `findingId` and `fingerprint` with identical values. This duplicates state and creates a risk of future drift if one value is updated without the other.  
**Suggestion:** Keep a single canonical identity field, or only include `fingerprint` when it is semantically different from `findingId`.

findings.title: 3. Bound retained advisory finding history
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/5cac57cb5799a07696840b35dd38cc5e76de494b284a4353af4b286282a7fbec.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The `advisoryFindings` array aggregates a large number of historical observations without an evident retention bound. This conflicts with the bounded-resource-usage guardrail because repeated review runs can grow these artifacts indefinitely.  
**Suggestion:** Add an explicit cap for retained findings per artifact or per phase, and summarize or roll over older entries into separate bounded records.

findings.title: 4. Normalize empty evidence records
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/2b7b0eaab01e3bd101aef34b2320f302572c9e5ad76114e5cdf60c09d0049b77.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** PASS records still store empty `advisoryFindings` and `blockingFindings` arrays. Across multiple generated evidence files, this repeats boilerplate with no information value.  
**Suggestion:** Use a shared minimal schema for no-finding PASS records, either omitting empty arrays or replacing them with a single normalized `findings: []` field.

findings.title: 5. Collapse duplicate rejected evidence shape
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/77e8a71529de240afd51d67f771be3a78528634b5458ccea5b359425768b5859.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Rejected evidence records repeat the same structure for each finding: one-element `evidenceRefs`, `findingId`, identical `fingerprint`, and `summary`. This makes each record verbose and harder to scan.  
**Suggestion:** Introduce a compact shared finding reference shape, such as `{ "ref": "...", "summary": "..." }`, when the identity can be derived from the evidence ref.

findings.title: 2. Use consistent formatted JSON for review artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/def3a5a0e158ad9dca2d9d95a9f1cef30394d77a082c2c6eb29c08b05862cf02.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** This JSON artifact is committed as a single long line, while `review-history/*.json` files in the same change set are pretty-printed. The inconsistent format makes reviews and future diffs harder to inspect.  
**Suggestion:** Pretty-print the review-evidence JSON files using the same indentation style as `review-history/*.json`.

findings.title: 1. Remove duplicated finding payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-001.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The same two findings are stored twice: once in `blockingFindings` and again in `findings`, with duplicated IDs, fingerprints, titles, issue bodies, rationale, and requirement IDs. This increases drift risk if one copy is later updated independently.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical finding list and derive phase/severity-specific views from it, or reduce `blockingFindings` to references/summary fields that point to entries in `findings`.

findings.title: 3. Normalize repeated review-evidence shape
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/ecebc467db456197cc023436f49d152e36b2189ebe4cbbba9b0aaec630c45091.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Each `blockingFindings` entry repeats both `findingId` and `fingerprint`, and most entries use identical values. This mirrors duplication seen across the evidence artifacts and makes the schema noisier than necessary.  
**Suggestion:** If `findingId` and `fingerprint` are expected to be identical for review evidence, store only one canonical identifier or make the distinction explicit by documenting/using different fields only when they differ.

findings.title: 3. Normalize duplicated finding payloads

findings.title: 6. Avoid committing duplicate Markdown review records

findings.title: 7. Bound review history accumulation
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-010.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** The artifact retains 70 advisory proposals in full, and review history appears to accumulate per-attempt files without an explicit retention or truncation bound. This conflicts with the bounded-resource-usage guardrail.
**Suggestion:** Enforce a retention policy such as latest N attempts per phase plus summarized older records, and include truncation metadata like `omittedCount` when proposals are capped.

findings.title: 8. Remove duplicated proposal text inside advisory entries
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-010.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Each `nonBlockingImprovements[]` entry repeats the full formatted proposal in both `issue` and `suggestion`, and the same text is repeated again in `findings[].body`.
**Suggestion:** Store structured fields once, for example `file`, `requirementId`, `issue`, and `suggestion`, then render formatted proposal text only when producing Markdown or display output.

findings.title: 1. Remove duplicated proposal body fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-010.md`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Every non-blocking improvement repeats `**File:**`, `**Requirement:**`, `**Issue:**`, and `**Suggestion:**` inside the `Issue`/`Suggestion` fields, then repeats the suggestion again. This makes the review artifact noisy and harder to parse.  
**Suggestion:** Regenerate or normalize the artifact so each proposal has exactly one `File`, one `Requirement`, one `Issue`, and one `Suggestion` block.

findings.title: 2. Consolidate repeated review-history attempts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/spec-attempt-001.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `spec-attempt-001.json` and `spec-attempt-002.json` are structurally identical PASS records, differing only by timestamp and attempt number. Keeping full empty records for every passing attempt creates duplicate generated state.  
**Suggestion:** Store only the latest PASS attempt or compact repeated PASS attempts into a bounded summary with attempt count and last generated timestamp.

findings.title: 7. Add final newlines to Markdown artifacts
findings.body:

**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The Markdown file has no trailing newline, and the same formatting issue appears in the touched test attempt Markdown files. This creates avoidable diff noise.  
**Suggestion:** Ensure the review-history Markdown generator always writes a final newline.

findings.title: 3. Avoid committing duplicate Markdown and JSON review bodies
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-001.md`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The Markdown file duplicates the same substantive finding data already stored in `test-attempt-001.json`, including verdict, coverage artifact, targets, issues, required changes, and blocking rationale.  
**Suggestion:** Make one format canonical. Prefer storing JSON as the source of truth and generating Markdown on demand, or reduce the Markdown to a short pointer/summary.

findings.title: 4. Normalize finding records within test attempt JSON
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-001.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Each finding is stored twice: once in `blockingFindings` and again in `findings`, with duplicated title, issue/body, fingerprint, disposition, rationale, and requirement-related metadata. The two shapes also use inconsistent names such as `issue` versus `body` and `kind` versus `severity`.  
**Suggestion:** Store each finding once in a canonical schema, then derive grouped views like `blockingFindings` from severity, or make grouped sections contain only `findingId` references.

findings.title: 5. Fix ambiguous repeated identifiers
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-001.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Multiple distinct findings share the same `findingId` and `fingerprint`, for example several unrelated R8/R1/R5/R4 coverage findings all use `0faa63...`. This makes it unclear whether the entries are separate findings or repeated instances of one finding.  
**Suggestion:** Generate location- or content-specific identifiers for independently actionable findings, or model them as one parent finding with a bounded `locations`/`occurrences` array.

findings.title: 6. Apply the same canonical finding schema to second test attempt
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-002.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `test-attempt-002.json` repeats the same two-shape finding model as attempt 001, duplicating full finding payloads under both `blockingFindings` and `findings`.  
**Suggestion:** Use the same normalized finding serializer for all test attempt artifacts so schema changes and render behavior are centralized.

findings.title: 8. Bound retained review-history artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-002.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The change introduces per-attempt history files, but the artifact set shows no explicit retention bound. Repeated spec/test review retries can grow this directory without limit, which conflicts with the bounded-resource-usage guardrail.  
**Suggestion:** Enforce a retention policy such as keeping the latest N attempts per phase and compacting older attempts into a bounded summary.

findings.title: 5. Normalize Repeated Finding Fields

**Suggestion:** Store findings once and derive grouped views such as `blockingFindings` from `findings` by severity, or replace duplicated full objects with references by ID.

findings.title: 1. Remove Duplicated Markdown Review Artifacts

findings.title: 1. Deduplicate Work Unit Identity Metadata
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/work-units/impl-review/2802ea34b3003a0b446168d0.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The same metadata is stored both at the top level and under `identity`: `unitId`, `targetFiles`, `inputHash`, `providerIdentity`, `promptVersion`, and `schemaVersion`. This creates two sources of truth inside one artifact.
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical location for execution identity. For example, keep immutable identity fields under `identity` and remove duplicated top-level copies, or reduce `identity` to only `stableOrderKey`, `parentUnitId`, and `commandId`.

findings.title: 2. Avoid Persisting Raw And Parsed Proposal Copies
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/work-units/impl-review/0bdf3b707356690edf741e13.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `rawResponse` stores the full Markdown proposal text while `success.proposals` stores the same content as parsed structured data. This duplicates large payloads and risks drift if parsing rules change.
**Suggestion:** Persist `success.proposals` as the canonical result. If raw provider output is required for debugging, store it only for failed parses or behind an explicit bounded debug/provenance field.

findings.title: 3. Add Explicit Bound For Raw Provider Output
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/work-units/impl-review/427dfbd203456f4fae825b67.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `rawResponse` can grow with provider output size, and the artifact format does not show a clear size cap. This conflicts with the `bounded-resource-usage` guardrail for bulk persisted data.
**Suggestion:** Enforce a maximum stored `rawResponse` length, truncate with a marker plus digest, or omit raw output after successful parsing.

findings.title: 5. Generate Markdown From JSON Instead Of Duplicating Review Content

findings.title: 1. Remove Duplicate Identity Fields

findings.title: 2. Remove Duplicate Identity Fields

findings.title: 5. Eliminate Raw Response Duplication
findings.body:

**Issue:** Proposal content is stored twice: once as a Markdown blob in `rawResponse` and again as parsed proposal objects.  
**Suggestion:** Drop the full raw response after successful parsing, or store a compact parse audit such as response hash plus proposal count.

findings.title: 3. Remove Duplicate Identity Fields

findings.title: 6. Eliminate Raw Response Duplication
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/work-units/impl-review/f11405f01831676c001ddd2a.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The artifact stores full proposal text in both `rawResponse` and `success.proposals`, duplicating the largest field in the file.  
**Suggestion:** Persist only the structured proposals for successful runs and reserve raw output for failed parse diagnostics.

findings.title: 7. Fix Out-Of-Scope Stored Proposals
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/work-units/impl-review/f11405f01831676c001ddd2a.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Several stored proposals reference files that are not in this work unit’s `targetFiles`, such as `impl-attempt-001.json`, `impl-attempt-002.md`, `draft-coverage-triage.json`, `flow.json`, `draft-gate-source.json`, and `src/lib/plugin-registry.js`. That violates the stated scope constraint embedded in the review task.  
**Suggestion:** Filter provider proposals before persistence so only proposals whose `file` appears in the work unit’s `targetFiles` are retained.

findings.title: 8. Consolidate Repeated Scenario Evidence
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/scenario-validity-result.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Each `summary[]` entry repeats identical `test_file`, `command`, and `raw_output_lines` values. Only `id`, `classification`, and `test_name` vary.  
**Suggestion:** Move shared evidence fields to a top-level `evidence` object and keep per-requirement entries focused on the fields that differ.

findings.title: 10. Resolve Contradictory Gate Status
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/spec-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** This artifact records `"result": "fail"` for schema validation, while the change set also includes `spec-review.json` with `"verdict": "PASS"` and `spec.json` approval notes saying the spec gate passed. The generated evidence is inconsistent.  
**Suggestion:** Regenerate or remove stale gate-source output so the committed artifacts represent one consistent gate result.

findings.title: 9. Remove Empty Markdown Placeholders
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/spec.md`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `Clarifications (Q&A)` renders empty `Q` and `A` bullets, and `Open Questions` renders an empty checkbox even though `spec.json` has empty arrays for both. These are dead placeholders.  
**Suggestion:** Suppress empty sections during rendering, or render a compact explicit empty state only if the format requires it.

findings.title: 1. Deduplicate Repeated Guardrail Findings
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/task-impl-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R7  
**Issue:** The same `no-overengineering` finding is duplicated across both `evaluations` and top-level `observations`, with near-identical rationale text and repeated metadata. This makes the artifact harder to inspect and increases the chance that repair tooling treats one issue as multiple distinct failures.  
**Suggestion:** Store the canonical finding once, then reference it from the alternate view by `findingId`/`fingerprint`, or collapse duplicate observations that share the same fingerprint before writing the artifact.

findings.title: 2. Avoid Repeated Test Evidence Blocks
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/test-execute-result.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Each requirement summary repeats the same `command`, `test_file`, and `raw_output_lines` values. The only meaningful per-entry differences are the requirement id, result, and test name.  
**Suggestion:** Move shared execution metadata into a top-level evidence object, and keep per-requirement entries limited to `id`, `result`, and `test_name` unless a requirement genuinely has different evidence.

findings.title: 3. Remove Duplicate Changed File Lists
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/test-execute-result.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `regression.trigger_relevant_changed_files` and `regression.changed_files` contain the same five file entries with identical fingerprints. This duplicates bulk data without adding distinct meaning.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical changed-file list and add a compact flag or reference for “trigger relevant” files when the sets are identical.

findings.title: 1. Extract Repeated Hook Snapshot Construction
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/tests/required-hook-failure-policy.test.js`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The test repeatedly builds near-identical `flowCommandHooks` snapshot objects inline, which makes policy, module, command, and hook variations harder to scan and easier to update inconsistently.  
**Suggestion:** Add a helper such as `hookSnapshot({ policy, module = "hooks/prepare.js", className = "FixtureHook", command = "prepare", hook = "post" })` and use it across the registry/lifecycle tests.

findings.title: 2. Reuse Finalize Hook Fixture Writer
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/tests/required-hook-failure-policy.test.js`  
**Requirement:** R6  
**Issue:** The finalize-cleanup tests duplicate inline hook file creation for required finalize hooks, including directory creation, module path, class shape, and snapshot entries.  
**Suggestion:** Add a focused helper like `writeFinalizeHook(projectRoot, { className, body, policy = "required" })` plus a matching snapshot helper. This keeps the atomicity tests focused on state assertions instead of fixture plumbing.

findings.title: 3. Consolidate Plugin Lifecycle Failure Envelope Builders
findings.body:
**File:** `src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js`  
**Requirement:** R7  
**Issue:** Required hook failures are converted to `Envelope.fail(...)` in both `finalizeRequiredPluginHookFailure()` and an inline block inside `runTeardownTransactionOwned()`, with slightly different payload shapes.  
**Suggestion:** Reuse `finalizeRequiredPluginHookFailure(pluginLifecycle)` inside `runTeardownTransactionOwned()` or extend it to accept a `primaryError`/metadata option. This removes duplication and keeps required lifecycle failure formatting consistent.

findings.title: 4. Rename `composeFinalizePluginLifecycle`
findings.body:
**File:** `src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js`  
**Requirement:** R2  
**Issue:** `composeFinalizePluginLifecycle(pre, post)` assumes `post` is terminal hook execution data, not necessarily a full lifecycle. The current name overlaps conceptually with `runFlowCommandWithPluginLifecycle` and obscures that it only merges pre/post hook runner outputs.  
**Suggestion:** Rename it to `composeFinalizeHookRunResult` or `mergeFinalizeHookResults` to match what the function actually combines.

findings.title: 5. Remove Redundant Catch In `writeFlowState`
findings.body:
**File:** `src/flow/lib/run-prepare-spec.js`  
**Requirement:** R7  
**Issue:** `writeFlowState()` wraps its lifecycle block in `try { ... } catch (error) { throw error; }`, which adds no behavior and makes the control flow noisier.  
**Suggestion:** Delete the redundant `try/catch` and let errors propagate directly.

findings.title: 6. Split Pre-Hook Atomic Write Behavior From `writeFlowState`
findings.body:
**File:** `src/flow/lib/run-prepare-spec.js`  
**Requirement:** R6  
**Issue:** `writeFlowState(extra, writePrepareFiles)` now both prepares state and controls when spec files are written through a callback. The parameter name reads like a boolean but is a function, and the function now hides an important atomicity boundary.  
**Suggestion:** Rename the parameter to `writePreparedArtifacts` or extract the lifecycle-wrapped prepare write into a clearer helper, e.g. `runPrepareLifecycleAndPersistState(...)`, so the pre-hook-before-write behavior is explicit.

findings.title: 7. Add A Common Failure Policy Snapshot Helper
findings.body:
**File:** `tests/unit/flow/finalize-cleanup-transaction-v2.test.js`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The test now repeats `failurePolicy: "advisory"` / `"required"` in hook class definitions and matching snapshot objects. That duplication is easy to desynchronize.  
**Suggestion:** Introduce a small local helper for finalize hook snapshots or constants for common policy-bearing hook metadata, then spread/override only the policy-specific fields per test.

findings.title: 8. Avoid Committing Raw Scenario Failure Logs
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/tests/.raw/scenario-validity.log`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** This 6k-line raw log embeds a full source dump from a failing assertion, making the diff noisy and hard to review. It also duplicates historical failed output that is superseded by `test-execution.log`.  
**Suggestion:** Remove this artifact if it is not required by the workflow, or regenerate it as a bounded summary containing only command metadata and failing test names.

findings.title: 1. Extract repeated mock transition application
findings.body:
**File:** `tests/unit/flow/set-step-impl-repair.test.js`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The mocked `updateStepStatus` implementation repeats the same transition-change application logic in multiple test cases. This makes future API changes or status mutation behavior easy to update inconsistently.  
**Suggestion:** Extract a local helper such as `applyStepTransition(state, transition)` or `createFlowManager(state, transitions)` and reuse it across these tests.

findings.title: 2. Avoid silent fixture cleanup with `force: true`
findings.body:
**File:** `tests/unit/flow/set-step-impl-repair.test.js`  
**Requirement:** R2  
**Issue:** Changing `fs.rmSync(... )` to `fs.rmSync(..., { force: true })` hides cases where the expected fixture files were never created. In a unit test, that can mask setup drift and reduce the test’s diagnostic value.  
**Suggestion:** If the files are expected to exist, keep the strict removal. If absence is valid for this scenario, add an explicit comment or assertion around that condition so the intent is clear.

findings.title: 1. Normalize Review Finding Schema Across Artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-006.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Multiple review artifact families repeat the same finding payload in parallel fields such as `blockingFindings` and `findings`, while also using inconsistent field names like `issue` vs `body`, `kind` vs `severity`, and `failureMode` vs `category`. This appears across impl, test, and evidence artifacts, creating cross-file schema drift.
**Suggestion:** Define one canonical persisted finding schema with stable identity, severity/category, file, requirement, issue, suggestion, and rationale fields. Derive grouped views such as `blockingFindings` from that schema, or store grouped sections as ID references only.

findings.title: 2. Use One Canonical Human/Structured Review Format
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-003.md`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Many `.md` review-history files duplicate the substantive content already present in adjacent `.json` files. This creates two sources of truth across files for verdicts, findings, file paths, requirements, rationales, and suggestions.
**Suggestion:** Persist JSON as the canonical review artifact and generate Markdown on demand, or reduce Markdown artifacts to compact summaries that reference the JSON artifact.

findings.title: 3. Standardize Review Evidence JSON Formatting
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/def3a5a0e158ad9dca2d9d95a9f1cef30394d77a082c2c6eb29c08b05862cf02.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Review evidence files are emitted as large single-line JSON while nearby review-history JSON files are pretty-printed. The inconsistent formatting across artifact directories makes diffs, conflict resolution, and manual inspection harder.
**Suggestion:** Use one stable JSON writer convention for generated review artifacts, preferably `JSON.stringify(record, null, 2) + "\n"`.

findings.title: 4. Consolidate Duplicate Finding Identity Fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/ecebc467db456197cc023436f49d152e36b2189ebe4cbbba9b0aaec630c45091.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Several artifact types store both `findingId` and `fingerprint`, often with identical values, while other findings reuse the same ID/fingerprint for distinct locations. This makes cross-file deduplication and repair targeting ambiguous.
**Suggestion:** Define clear semantics: use one canonical stable ID per actionable finding, and only store a separate fingerprint when it is intentionally different. Include locator/content components when distinct occurrences need separate identities.

findings.title: 5. Apply A Shared Retention Policy To Generated Review State
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Multiple generated state files can grow without visible bounds, including flow metrics/history, review-history attempts, review-evidence findings, raw provider responses, issue-log payloads, and repair fingerprints. The same bounded-resource concern appears across independent artifact families.
**Suggestion:** Add a shared retention/compaction policy for generated workflow artifacts, such as latest N records per phase plus `omittedCount`, digest, or summarized older entries.

findings.title: 6. Deduplicate Raw Provider Output And Parsed Proposals
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/work-units/impl-review/d7e860f04f301bf9cac6a177.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Work-unit artifacts persist full `rawResponse` text while also storing parsed proposal objects, and similar proposal text is later repeated in review-history JSON/Markdown. This duplicates large payloads across files and increases drift risk.
**Suggestion:** Keep parsed structured proposals as canonical. Retain raw provider output only for failed parses or as a bounded diagnostic excerpt plus hash.

findings.title: 7. Reuse Shared Empty Artifact Templates
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-review-coverage.json`
**Requirement:** R3
**Issue:** Empty PASS, triage, repair, and evidence artifacts repeat nearly identical schemas across coverage/questions/spec/test flows, differing only by phase, source pointer, timestamp, and summary text.
**Suggestion:** Generate empty artifacts from shared helpers or schemas parameterized by phase/source fields, so shape changes are applied consistently across all generated files.

findings.title: 8. Align Hook Failure Policy Snapshot Shape
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow.json`
**Requirement:** R1
**Issue:** Runtime/test hook snapshots include failure policy metadata in some places, while generated `plugins.flowCommandHooks` snapshots omit it. This creates an interface inconsistency between implementation expectations, tests, and committed flow artifacts.
**Suggestion:** Make `failurePolicy` part of the canonical hook snapshot schema and ensure all snapshot writers, test fixtures, and flow artifacts populate it consistently.

findings.title: 9. Consolidate Hook Failure Envelope Construction
findings.body:
**File:** `src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js`
**Requirement:** R7
**Issue:** Required hook failures are converted into failure envelopes in multiple code paths with slightly different payload shapes. That risks inconsistent failure reporting between finalize cleanup paths and other lifecycle handling.
**Suggestion:** Route required hook failure formatting through one helper, or extend the existing helper to accept path-specific metadata while preserving one output schema.

findings.title: 10. Normalize Shared Test Fixture Builders
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/tests/required-hook-failure-policy.test.js`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Hook snapshot construction and finalize hook fixture creation are repeated across tests, while related unit tests also duplicate transition application logic. These repeated fixtures can drift as the hook lifecycle interface changes.
**Suggestion:** Add small local helpers for hook snapshots, finalize hook files, and mocked step transitions, then use overrides only for fields that differ per scenario.

**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical representation. For example, make `evaluations[].observations` the source of truth and remove top-level `observations`, or keep top-level `observations` and have `evaluations` reference observation IDs instead of embedding duplicate objects.

findings.title: 1. Remove duplicated finding payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The same guardrail failures are represented twice, once in `evaluations` and again in top-level `observations`, with largely duplicated fields. This increases artifact size and creates drift risk because the two copies already differ in `findingId`, `fingerprint`, and one `reportedAt` value.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical representation. For example, make `evaluations[].observations` the source of truth and remove top-level `observations`, or keep top-level `observations` and have `evaluations` reference observation IDs instead of embedding duplicate objects.

findings.title: 2. Preserve per-location identity for repeated findings
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R2  
**Issue:** Multiple `prioritize-requirements` failures at different locators share the same `findingId` and `fingerprint` inside `evaluations`, even though they point to different locations such as `$.decisionMap.deferredToSpec[0]`, `[1]`, and `[2]`. This makes deduplication and repair targeting ambiguous.  
**Suggestion:** Include the locator, requirement reference, or another stable location component in the fingerprint input so repeated rule violations at different locations remain distinguishable.

findings.title: 3. Consolidate empty review artifact structure
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-review-coverage.json`  
**Requirement:** R3  
**Issue:** `draft-review-coverage.json` and `draft-review-questions.json` have identical structure and only differ by phase, source timing, and filename. If these are hand-authored or generated by nearby logic, this duplication suggests the artifact schema is being repeated rather than reused.  
**Suggestion:** Use a shared review artifact template/schema for empty PASS reviews, parameterized by `phase`, `sourceDraft`, and `generatedAt`, so future changes to review artifact fields happen in one place.

findings.title: 4. Consolidate empty triage/repair artifact structure
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-coverage-triage.json`  
**Requirement:** R4  
**Issue:** The triage and repair artifacts repeat the same empty-result shape across coverage and questions flows: `version`, `phase`, source pointer, `generatedAt`, `summary`, and empty `items`. This is low-value duplication and can produce inconsistent summaries or field names over time.  
**Suggestion:** Generate these from a common empty-artifact helper or schema, with the source field name and summary text supplied as parameters.

findings.title: 1. Deduplicate Requirement File Lists
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/file-map.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** R2, R3, and R4 repeat the same file list, and R6/R7 repeat most of that same set. This makes the map noisy and easy to update inconsistently.
**Suggestion:** If the schema supports it, introduce shared file groups or generate the requirement map from canonical metadata so repeated path arrays are not hand-maintained.

findings.title: 2. Collapse Duplicate Finding Identity Fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow-findings.json`
**Requirement:** R6
**Issue:** Each entry stores identical values in `sourceFindingId` and `fingerprint`, and also has both `disposition` and `finalDisposition`. These paired fields can drift without adding clear value in this artifact.
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical finding ID and one current/final state field, or document and enforce distinct semantics if both are required.

findings.title: 3. Add Bounded Flow History Retention
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Arrays such as `metrics`, `stepAttempts`, `reviewRecoveryBaselines`, and `reviewConvergence.records[].evidenceHistory` appear append-only and can grow indefinitely, violating `bounded-resource-usage`.
**Suggestion:** Add an explicit retention policy, such as latest N records per phase/task plus `omittedCount` or compacted summary metadata.

findings.title: 4. Remove Stale In-Progress State
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** `impl-review` is marked `"in_progress"` even though later state shows review, gates, and regression steps have run. That makes the generated flow state internally inconsistent.
**Suggestion:** Regenerate or update the flow artifact so `impl-review` has a terminal status and matching completion metadata.

findings.title: 5. Filter Persisted Triage Noise
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/impl-triage.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** The artifact persists many rejected proposals, including items that are only historical/noise for the review surface. This makes the useful triage output hard to inspect.
**Suggestion:** Persist only actionable triage items for this change set, or compact rejected/out-of-scope items into bounded summary counts.

findings.title: 6. Normalize Issue Log Payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/issue-log.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Entries repeat the same long text across `reason`, `observations`, and `failedEvaluations`, and the log has no visible retention bound.
**Suggestion:** Store canonical observations once, reference or summarize them from other fields, and enforce max retained entries or max payload size.

findings.title: 7. Reduce Bilingual Duplication
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/issue.md`
**Requirement:** R2
**Issue:** The English and Japanese sections duplicate the full issue body, creating two sources of truth for requirements, scope, acceptance criteria, and evidence.
**Suggestion:** Keep one authoritative requirements section and make the localized section a concise translation summary, or explicitly mark one section as non-authoritative.

findings.title: 8. Remove Duplicate Issue Number State
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/plugin-artifacts/workflow/prepare.json`
**Requirement:** R2
**Issue:** The issue number is stored as both top-level `issue` and `result.issueNumber`.
**Suggestion:** Store the issue number once, preferably in `result.issueNumber` unless the top-level field is required as an artifact key.

findings.title: 9. Avoid Persisting Transient Workflow Mutation Details
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/plugin-artifacts/workflow/prepare.json`
**Requirement:** R4
**Issue:** The artifact stores operational transition fields like `status`, `changed`, and `previousStatus`, which are transient side-effect details rather than durable spec data.
**Suggestion:** Omit these fields from committed artifacts, or move them into bounded local run evidence.

findings.title: 10. Bound Repair Fingerprint Entries
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/repair-fingerprint.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** `entries` records full changed-path metadata and can grow with repeated repair/regression cycles without an explicit cap.
**Suggestion:** Add a maximum retained entry count or compact repeated/unchanged metadata into a summary with `omittedCount`.

findings.title: 1. Pretty-print generated review evidence JSON
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/5cac57cb5799a07696840b35dd38cc5e76de494b284a4353af4b286282a7fbec.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The file is a very large single-line JSON object, which makes review, conflict resolution, and targeted edits unnecessarily difficult.  
**Suggestion:** Emit review evidence with stable pretty-printing, for example `JSON.stringify(record, null, 2) + "\n"`, and apply the same formatting convention to these evidence artifacts.

findings.title: 2. Deduplicate repeated finding identity fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/5cac57cb5799a07696840b35dd38cc5e76de494b284a4353af4b286282a7fbec.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Every finding stores both `findingId` and `fingerprint` with identical values. This duplicates state and creates a risk of future drift if one value is updated without the other.  
**Suggestion:** Keep a single canonical identity field, or only include `fingerprint` when it is semantically different from `findingId`.

findings.title: 3. Bound retained advisory finding history
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/5cac57cb5799a07696840b35dd38cc5e76de494b284a4353af4b286282a7fbec.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The `advisoryFindings` array aggregates a large number of historical observations without an evident retention bound. This conflicts with the bounded-resource-usage guardrail because repeated review runs can grow these artifacts indefinitely.  
**Suggestion:** Add an explicit cap for retained findings per artifact or per phase, and summarize or roll over older entries into separate bounded records.

findings.title: 4. Normalize empty evidence records
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/2b7b0eaab01e3bd101aef34b2320f302572c9e5ad76114e5cdf60c09d0049b77.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** PASS records still store empty `advisoryFindings` and `blockingFindings` arrays. Across multiple generated evidence files, this repeats boilerplate with no information value.  
**Suggestion:** Use a shared minimal schema for no-finding PASS records, either omitting empty arrays or replacing them with a single normalized `findings: []` field.

findings.title: 5. Collapse duplicate rejected evidence shape
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/77e8a71529de240afd51d67f771be3a78528634b5458ccea5b359425768b5859.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Rejected evidence records repeat the same structure for each finding: one-element `evidenceRefs`, `findingId`, identical `fingerprint`, and `summary`. This makes each record verbose and harder to scan.  
**Suggestion:** Introduce a compact shared finding reference shape, such as `{ "ref": "...", "summary": "..." }`, when the identity can be derived from the evidence ref.

findings.title: 2. Use consistent formatted JSON for review artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/def3a5a0e158ad9dca2d9d95a9f1cef30394d77a082c2c6eb29c08b05862cf02.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** This JSON artifact is committed as a single long line, while `review-history/*.json` files in the same change set are pretty-printed. The inconsistent format makes reviews and future diffs harder to inspect.  
**Suggestion:** Pretty-print the review-evidence JSON files using the same indentation style as `review-history/*.json`.

findings.title: 1. Remove duplicated finding payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-001.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The same two findings are stored twice: once in `blockingFindings` and again in `findings`, with duplicated IDs, fingerprints, titles, issue bodies, rationale, and requirement IDs. This increases drift risk if one copy is later updated independently.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical finding list and derive phase/severity-specific views from it, or reduce `blockingFindings` to references/summary fields that point to entries in `findings`.

findings.title: 3. Normalize repeated review-evidence shape
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/ecebc467db456197cc023436f49d152e36b2189ebe4cbbba9b0aaec630c45091.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Each `blockingFindings` entry repeats both `findingId` and `fingerprint`, and most entries use identical values. This mirrors duplication seen across the evidence artifacts and makes the schema noisier than necessary.  
**Suggestion:** If `findingId` and `fingerprint` are expected to be identical for review evidence, store only one canonical identifier or make the distinction explicit by documenting/using different fields only when they differ.

findings.title: 1. Add missing file path to the second blocking finding
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-004.md`
**Requirement:** R6
**Issue:** The second proposal, “Command atomicity paths are not implemented,” is missing the mandatory `**File:** <path>` line even though the review contract says proposals without that line will be discarded.
**Suggestion:** Add `**File:** src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js` or the exact touched implementation file that the finding targets.

findings.title: 2. Add missing `file` field in the JSON finding
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-004.json`
**Requirement:** R6
**Issue:** The second `blockingFindings` entry lacks a `file` property, while the other findings include one. This makes the JSON and Markdown review artifacts inconsistent and weakens machine processing of scoped findings.
**Suggestion:** Add `"file": "src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js"` or the exact touched implementation file that the finding targets to the `command-atomicity-callers-not-updated` finding.

findings.title: 1. Add missing file path to the second blocking finding
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-009.md`
**Requirement:** R6
**Issue:** The second proposal, “Command atomicity paths are not implemented,” is missing the mandatory `**File:** <path>` line even though the review contract says proposals without that line will be discarded.
**Suggestion:** Add `**File:** src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js` or the exact touched implementation file that the finding targets.

findings.title: 2. Add missing `file` field in the JSON finding
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-009.md`
**Requirement:** R6
**Issue:** The second `blockingFindings` entry lacks a `file` property, while the other findings include one. This makes the JSON and Markdown review artifacts inconsistent and weakens machine processing of scoped findings.
**Suggestion:** Add `"file": "src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js"` or the exact touched implementation file that the finding targets to the `command-atomicity-callers-not-updated` finding.

findings.title: 1. Normalize duplicated finding payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-006.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** The same finding is stored twice in `blockingFindings` and `findings`, with equivalent content but different field names such as `issue` vs `body` and `failureMode` vs `category`.
**Suggestion:** Store one canonical finding record and derive the grouped `blockingFindings` view from `findings`, or make `blockingFindings` contain only `findingId` references.

findings.title: 4. Avoid committing duplicate Markdown review records
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-006.md`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** The Markdown file repeats the same review content already stored structurally in `impl-attempt-006.json`.
**Suggestion:** Treat JSON as canonical and generate Markdown on demand, or reduce the Markdown file to a compact summary that points to the JSON artifact.

findings.title: 2. Normalize duplicated finding payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-007.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Both findings are duplicated across `blockingFindings` and `findings`, increasing artifact size and creating drift risk between two serialized representations.
**Suggestion:** Keep a single canonical findings array with severity/category fields, then derive blocking/non-blocking groupings when rendering or reading.

findings.title: 5. Avoid committing duplicate Markdown review records
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-007.md`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** The Markdown file duplicates verdict, findings, file paths, requirement IDs, issues, suggestions, dispositions, and rationales already present in `impl-attempt-007.json`.
**Suggestion:** Generate this Markdown from the JSON artifact instead of storing two full sources of truth.

findings.title: 3. Normalize duplicated finding payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-008.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** The sole finding is duplicated in both `blockingFindings[0]` and `findings[0]`, including title, rationale, fingerprint, disposition, requirement, and repeat count.
**Suggestion:** Persist the finding once and have one section reference the other by `findingId`.

findings.title: 6. Avoid committing duplicate Markdown review records
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-008.md`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** The Markdown report repeats the same substantive finding data already present in `impl-attempt-008.json`.
**Suggestion:** Keep a single canonical artifact format, or make Markdown a lightweight rendered view generated from JSON.

findings.title: 7. Bound review history accumulation
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-010.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** The artifact retains 70 advisory proposals in full, and review history appears to accumulate per-attempt files without an explicit retention or truncation bound. This conflicts with the bounded-resource-usage guardrail.
**Suggestion:** Enforce a retention policy such as latest N attempts per phase plus summarized older records, and include truncation metadata like `omittedCount` when proposals are capped.

findings.title: 8. Remove duplicated proposal text inside advisory entries
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-010.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Each `nonBlockingImprovements[]` entry repeats the full formatted proposal in both `issue` and `suggestion`, and the same text is repeated again in `findings[].body`.
**Suggestion:** Store structured fields once, for example `file`, `requirementId`, `issue`, and `suggestion`, then render formatted proposal text only when producing Markdown or display output.

findings.title: 1. Remove duplicated proposal body fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-010.md`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Every non-blocking improvement repeats `**File:**`, `**Requirement:**`, `**Issue:**`, and `**Suggestion:**` inside the `Issue`/`Suggestion` fields, then repeats the suggestion again. This makes the review artifact noisy and harder to parse.  
**Suggestion:** Regenerate or normalize the artifact so each proposal has exactly one `File`, one `Requirement`, one `Issue`, and one `Suggestion` block.

findings.title: 2. Consolidate repeated review-history attempts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/spec-attempt-001.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `spec-attempt-001.json` and `spec-attempt-002.json` are structurally identical PASS records, differing only by timestamp and attempt number. Keeping full empty records for every passing attempt creates duplicate generated state.  
**Suggestion:** Store only the latest PASS attempt or compact repeated PASS attempts into a bounded summary with attempt count and last generated timestamp.

findings.title: 7. Add final newlines to Markdown artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/spec-attempt-001.md`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The Markdown file has no trailing newline, and the same formatting issue appears in the touched test attempt Markdown files. This creates avoidable diff noise.  
**Suggestion:** Ensure the review-history Markdown generator always writes a final newline.

findings.title: 7. Add final newlines to Markdown artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/spec-attempt-002.md`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The Markdown file has no trailing newline, and the same formatting issue appears in the touched test attempt Markdown files. This creates avoidable diff noise.  
**Suggestion:** Ensure the review-history Markdown generator always writes a final newline.

findings.title: 7. Add final newlines to Markdown artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/spec-review.md`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The Markdown file has no trailing newline, and the same formatting issue appears in the touched test attempt Markdown files. This creates avoidable diff noise.  
**Suggestion:** Ensure the review-history Markdown generator always writes a final newline.

findings.title: 3. Avoid committing duplicate Markdown and JSON review bodies
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-001.md`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The Markdown file duplicates the same substantive finding data already stored in `test-attempt-001.json`, including verdict, coverage artifact, targets, issues, required changes, and blocking rationale.  
**Suggestion:** Make one format canonical. Prefer storing JSON as the source of truth and generating Markdown on demand, or reduce the Markdown to a short pointer/summary.

findings.title: 4. Normalize finding records within test attempt JSON
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-001.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Each finding is stored twice: once in `blockingFindings` and again in `findings`, with duplicated title, issue/body, fingerprint, disposition, rationale, and requirement-related metadata. The two shapes also use inconsistent names such as `issue` versus `body` and `kind` versus `severity`.  
**Suggestion:** Store each finding once in a canonical schema, then derive grouped views like `blockingFindings` from severity, or make grouped sections contain only `findingId` references.

findings.title: 5. Fix ambiguous repeated identifiers
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-001.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** Multiple distinct findings share the same `findingId` and `fingerprint`, for example several unrelated R8/R1/R5/R4 coverage findings all use `0faa63...`. This makes it unclear whether the entries are separate findings or repeated instances of one finding.  
**Suggestion:** Generate location- or content-specific identifiers for independently actionable findings, or model them as one parent finding with a bounded `locations`/`occurrences` array.

findings.title: 6. Apply the same canonical finding schema to second test attempt
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-002.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** `test-attempt-002.json` repeats the same two-shape finding model as attempt 001, duplicating full finding payloads under both `blockingFindings` and `findings`.  
**Suggestion:** Use the same normalized finding serializer for all test attempt artifacts so schema changes and render behavior are centralized.

findings.title: 8. Bound retained review-history artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-002.json`  
**Requirement:** R8  
**Issue:** The change introduces per-attempt history files, but the artifact set shows no explicit retention bound. Repeated spec/test review retries can grow this directory without limit, which conflicts with the bounded-resource-usage guardrail.  
**Suggestion:** Enforce a retention policy such as keeping the latest N attempts per phase and compacting older attempts into a bounded summary.

findings.title: 5. Normalize Repeated Finding Fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-003.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** Each finding is represented twice: once in `blockingFindings` and again in `findings`, with repeated `findingId`, `fingerprint`, `title`, `rationale`, and issue/body text.  
**Suggestion:** Store findings once and derive grouped views such as `blockingFindings` from `findings` by severity, or replace duplicated full objects with references by ID.

findings.title: 1. Remove Duplicated Markdown Review Artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-003.md`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The `.md` review history files duplicate the same finding data already stored structurally in the adjacent `.json` files. This creates two sources of truth for titles, issues, required changes, and rationale.  
**Suggestion:** Keep the JSON artifact as canonical and generate the Markdown view on demand, or omit committed Markdown history files if the workflow does not require both persisted formats.

findings.title: 6. Normalize Repeated Finding Fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-004.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The same finding data is duplicated across `blockingFindings` and `findings`, creating unnecessary redundancy.  
**Suggestion:** Use a single findings array and compute blocking/advisory groupings from `severity` or `kind`.

findings.title: 2. Remove Duplicated Markdown Review Artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-004.md`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** This file repeats the same review content that exists in `test-attempt-004.json`, increasing maintenance cost and drift risk.  
**Suggestion:** Store only the JSON artifact, or make the Markdown artifact generated/transient rather than committed.

findings.title: 7. Normalize Repeated Finding Fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-005.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The JSON repeats the same finding in two schema locations with mostly identical data.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical finding record and reference it where summary/grouped views are needed.

findings.title: 3. Remove Duplicated Markdown Review Artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-005.md`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The Markdown file is a duplicate representation of the JSON artifact with no additional information.  
**Suggestion:** Remove the committed Markdown copy unless a downstream consumer requires it; otherwise derive it from JSON.

findings.title: 8. Normalize Repeated Finding Fields
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-006.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** `blockingFindings[0]` and `findings[0]` duplicate the same review finding.  
**Suggestion:** Remove the duplicated representation or make one section contain only IDs/counts derived from the canonical findings list.

findings.title: 4. Remove Duplicated Markdown Review Artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-006.md`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** This duplicates `test-attempt-006.json` and adds another place where review history can become inconsistent.  
**Suggestion:** Prefer one canonical persisted format, ideally JSON, and generate human-readable output when needed.

findings.title: 4. Remove Duplicated Markdown Review Artifacts
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-007.md`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** This duplicates `test-attempt-006.json` and adds another place where review history can become inconsistent.
